name: Runner Extras - TestPage SetValue validates
brief: Pins that a TestPage SetValue on a Rec-bound control validates the field — running the table field's OnValidate and the control's own OnValidate — rather than assigning it raw.
description: Setting a field on a page is a Validate, not an assignment. That is the whole reason a card can fill in a description when you pick a code, refuse a value that breaks an invariant, or default one field from another. A runner that assigns raw stores the value the test wrote, so the field it was read back from is correct and every derived field is silently blank — and the test fails pointing at the derived field, which is the one place the bug is not.
